paragraphs: R. Yitzḥak bar Yaakov bar Giyori sent [a statement] in R. Yoḥanan's name, Ta'anit (29b), Ellu Megalleḥin (18a), chapter HaDar (42a as printed; compare 62a), Ketubbot (46, end of side a), chapter Gid HaNasheh (101b). In Rabbi's time (I did not find this).
